title: Autofill Integration & Credential Connection
message: GabAI v0.3.6 fixes login credential autofill, automatically connecting username and password fields with full support for Android Autofill and Google Password Manager.
changelog:
• Dual Credential Autofill: Perfectly links username and password fields in system Autofill and password managers
• Fixed InputType Bitmask: Cleaned keyboard type transitions between student and educator modes
• Autofill Session Management: Automatically triggers Save Password on successful login/registration
• Universal Visual Context: Works across all academic disciplines with Overview, Real-World, and Diagrams & Charts chips
